name: Textimate
description: Provides animated text effects using the Splitting library.
project_description:
Textimate is a innovative and powerful Drupal module that provides text animate, enhancing site interactivity with awesome effects. 

 Effortlessly transform static text into mesmerizing animations. 
 Overview 
 By seamlessly Textimate merging "text" and "animate" with combines the words "text" and "animate" to deliver an experience that's nothing short of amazing.

 Textimate using Splitting module to split text to characters or words etc. and with Animate.css module functionality and library will add animation to your text each character or words etc. 

 Features 
 
 User-Friendly Management Section: 
From beginners to advanced users, the module's management and configuration section is designed to be intuitive and easy to navigate. 
 Lightweight with Powerful Capabilities: 
Despite being lightweight, Textimate offers a wide range of possibilities to effortlessly create stunning animations and effects. This enhances the overall visual appeal of the website. 
 Customizable Animation Combinations: 
Users have the flexibility to choose from a variety of animations and even combine them to achieve unique and special effects. 
 JavaScript Event Integration: 
The module enables users to select different JavaScript events, allowing for precise control over when animations are triggered. 
 Flexible Animation Execution: 
Users can opt for animations to run based on letter or word splits, offering a granular level of customization. 
 Timing and Delay Options: 
Provides various options for users to fine-tune the animation start time, enabling them to create dynamic and engaging content with precision. 
 Universal Animation Implementation: 
Textimate breaks free from limitations. It empowers users to add effects anywhere and animations not only for outputs from other modules but also seamlessly integrates with slideshow text, system or views content blocks, and various content types, node titles etc. offering a wide canvas for creativity. 
 
 Usage 
 Enable Textimate module. Go to "admin/structure/textimate" to add effects and manage few options.

 Installation 
 Please view the project's README.md for detailed installation instruction.

 Requirements 
 
 Animate CSS module 
Allows you to makes cross-browser animations for use in your web projects. Great for emphasis, home pages, sliders, blocks with cool animation effects. 
 Splitting module 
Allows you to creates elements and adds CSS Variables for split words & characters! (lines, items, grids, images, more!) to unlock amazing possibilities for style and animating text, grids, and more! 
 
 Supporting 
 Please let me know if a new feature is needed or is there any issue and feedback. You can announce it in the Textimate Issues section.

 Animations can improve the UX of an interface, but keep in mind that they can also get in the way of your users! 

 Textimate empowers you to effortlessly transform ordinary text into extraordinary animations. Elevate your website's visual appeal and leave your audience awestruck. With just a few clicks, you can infuse life into your content, creating an immersive user experience that resonates.

 Whether you're a seasoned developer or a first-time Drupal user, Textimate is intuitively crafted to ensure a seamless integration into your project. Unlock a world of creative potential with a tool that's as versatile as it is powerful.
